title: Prevent stale and repetitive proactive PiBot delivery
description: Ensure heartbeats remain silent unless they contain new, meaningful, user-relevant information; suppress unchanged heartbeat output across ticks and restarts; and prevent dead-letter recovery from automatically replaying content through a stale transport/chat route.
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests prove: empty/non-actionable heartbeat decisions do not deliver; unchanged heartbeat output is not repeated; a genuinely changed actionable update is delivered; persisted anti-repeat state survives engine recreation; dead letters whose recorded route is no longer current remain queued and are not sent automatically; current-route dead letters still replay normally. No queue deletion, schedule mutation, credential change, or service restart.
close_reason: Implemented and verified: heartbeat duplicate suppression with private persistence; failed/partial replay quarantine; stale-route retention; queue-liveness and successful-fallback regressions. Focused 55/55 and typecheck pass. Full suite 297/298; sole failure is pre-existing local Whisper environment mismatch. Deployment/restart intentionally not performed.

title: heartbeat: adaptive self-paced wakeups (set_next_wakeup)
description: From razzant/ouroboros background consciousness (prompts/CONSCIOUSNESS.md): the agent decides its own next wakeup interval instead of a fixed rhythm — 300s default, 600-1800s when nothing is happening, shorter when something interesting is happening. Extend the heartbeat tick decision tool (speak/escalate/note) with a wakeup field that overrides the manifest interval; clamp to manifest min/max so agents can't go dark; quiet hours still apply. Payoff: idle agents become nearly free, attentive agents react faster.

title: Add privacy-safe unified operational trace view
description: Create one safe operational event view that correlates daemon activity, per-agent session/event lifecycle, cascade decisions, heartbeat/scheduler execution, and final delivery. Assign a trace ID at message or proactive-trigger ingress and propagate it through model selection, retries, routing, transport delivery, and terminal outcome. Expose metadata only: agent, trigger type, stage, status/outcome, latency, retry count, and normalized error category. Never store or surface message bodies, prompts, response text, secrets, tokens, credential values, or sensitive file contents.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A message, heartbeat, morning brief, or recovery replay can be followed end-to-end by one trace ID across daemon, agent, cascade, scheduler/heartbeat, and transport events. 2. The view reports stage timestamps, total/per-stage latency, retry count, route/transport metadata, final delivered/failed/skipped/queued outcome, and normalized error category. 3. Delivery targets are represented with privacy-safe opaque identifiers; no chat content or credential material appears in events, UI, logs, exports, or tests. 4. Retention is bounded, configurable, documented, and defaults to the shortest operationally useful period; expired trace data is deleted. 5. Access follows existing local dashboard authentication and owner-only file permissions. 6. Tests cover redaction, trace propagation, retries, heartbeat silence/delivery, stale routing, cascade recovery, retention expiry, and secret/message-content non-leakage.
notes: Privacy constraint: operational metadata must not become a second transcript store. Use data minimization, opaque correlation identifiers, explicit retention limits, owner-only permissions, and safe error categorization. Do not ingest historical private message content when backfilling or migrating.

title: events: consolidation pipeline — distill events into durable memory (Skill Forge blueprint)
description: Ouroboros consolidator.py + memory.py is the concrete blueprint for the roadmap item 'Skill Forge pattern-mining from event/session history'. Mechanics to adapt: block-based memory file (blocks JSON + regenerated markdown + journal); advance-only offset cursor over events.jsonl (meta records last-consumed offset); gap blocks so lost/skipped events are never silently dropped; cheap-model consolidation of unconsolidated events into summary blocks; older blocks compressed into eras; durable lessons promoted into knowledge/memory with an index. Trigger from evolution cycle or a heartbeat maintenance item (pairs with maintenance rotation). Output feeds skill proposals.

title: evolution: persistent improvement backlog feeding /evolve
description: Port Ouroboros improvement_backlog.py mechanics: per-agent improvement-backlog.md with '### id' + '- key: value' entries (fingerprint hash for dedup, recurrence counting instead of dropping, close-on-commit). Digest ranked priority > recurrence > recency, capped chars. Periodic LLM grooming pass: merge near-dupes, mark obsolete done, cap open items (~30). '/evolve' with no goal picks the top-ranked open item instead of ad-hoc goals; heartbeat and chats can append candidates as durable notes. Backlog stays advisory - only a gated evolution cycle may implement.

title: heartbeat: maintenance rotation checklist (one item per wakeup)
description: Adapt Ouroboros prompts/CONSCIOUSNESS.md Maintenance Protocol: on each heartbeat tick the agent runs a fixed checklist and picks exactly ONE stale item to maintain, rotating — (1) memory freshness, (2) persona/identity freshness, (3) scratchpad freshness, (4) knowledge-gap skim of recent chat, (5) process lessons -> durable memory, (6) improvement backlog digest, (7) tech radar every Nth tick. Core rule: never do all items at once; nothing rots more than a few cycles; if everything is fresh, save budget and set a longer wakeup (pairs with pibot-ourowake). Implement in heartbeat.ts digest construction + document pattern in HEARTBEAT.md template.

title: Add owner-confirmed Telegram avatar generation
description: Add a deterministic local JPG avatar renderer, opt-in external image-provider interfaces (OpenAI GPT Image and future Nano Banana-compatible) without bundled credentials or automatic calls, and an explicit owner-confirmed capability that applies a selected generated artifact to the invoking Telegram bot via setMyProfilePhoto. Never rotate automatically. Keep artifacts in runtime data, validate ownership/path/format, and document privacy/configuration.
design: Use agent-scoped avatar capability but route apply through the invoking ChatRef transport. Store artifacts under runtime data, keyed by agent and transport, with generated opaque ids and path containment validation. Deterministic local renderer emits Telegram-required JPG. External providers implement one interface and remain unavailable until environment/config is supplied; discovery never calls them. Apply is a distinct tool and always uses the existing owner Confirm/Cancel flow; no scheduler/heartbeat hook.
acceptance_criteria: Local provider deterministically produces a Telegram-compatible JPG without API keys; provider registry exposes configured/unconfigured status and does not make external requests during discovery/tests; generated artifacts are scoped to the invoking agent/transport in runtime data; apply requires explicit owner confirmation and targets only the invoking Telegram transport; no automatic profile change path exists; focused tests cover deterministic output, provider gating, selection/path safety, confirmation cancellation, and Telegram adapter; README documents configuration and secret handling.
close_reason: Implemented in working tree: deterministic local JPG renderer; provider registry with inert OpenAI/Nano-Banana-compatible adapters; private durable agent+transport-scoped artifacts; opt-in owner-confirmed Telegram apply; documentation and tests. Typecheck and 76 focused/integration tests pass. Full suite 307/308 with only the pre-existing local Whisper environment mismatch.

title: media: complete safe Telegram audio round-trip
description: Complete the Telegram speech pipeline without automatic or proactive audio. Inbound: support native voice, audio, video_note, and validated audio documents; download within Telegram and project limits, extract only the audio track from video notes locally, transcribe, and route the transcript through the invoking transport and current or bound agent exactly like a user turn. Outbound: add an agent-scoped opt-in speech capability with provider abstraction, private generated artifacts, and transport methods for Telegram voice messages and music-player audio. Local generation is the default; external TTS or STT is disabled unless explicitly configured and permitted for that agent. Reuse the existing rate limit and duplicate guard; never attach speech generation to heartbeat, schedules, replay, or automatic reply conversion. Coordinate retention with pibot-7bo.
design: Phase 1 hardens ingestion: extend IncomingMedia for video_note, accept audio documents only after MIME and media probing, use execFile-based ffmpeg extraction with duration, byte, timeout, and output limits, and resolve the target agent before choosing STT policy. Keep transcripts as user content, not system instructions, and preserve pending-question behavior. Phase 2 adds Telegram sendVoice and sendAudio adapters plus an agent-scoped speech capability with separate generate and send actions targeting only the invoking chat. Use a local macOS say plus ffmpeg adapter first behind a provider interface; generated voice output is OGG Opus or another Telegram-supported voice format, while audio output is MP3 or M4A. Phase 3 adds optional external adapters such as OpenAI, Groq Orpheus, or ElevenLabs with secret presence checks, per-agent provider allowlists, no discovery calls, and explicit owner intent for paid or external generation. Artifacts and downloads stay outside Git with owner-only permissions and bounded retention; operational events contain metadata only, never transcript or audio content.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Focused tests cover message:voice, message:audio, message:video_note, and valid or invalid audio documents, including size, duration, missing-audio-track, malformed-media, timeout, and download failure cases. 2. Video-note audio is extracted locally with argument-safe process execution and the transcript reaches only the agent bound to the invoking bot or selected in that exact chat. 3. Pending questions can be answered by all supported speech inputs; spoken slash commands never become host commands accidentally. 4. STT policy is local-first and external transcription occurs only when that provider is configured and allowed for the resolved agent; tests prove no external call during discovery or when disallowed. 5. An opt-in agent capability can generate locally and send either Telegram voice via sendVoice or audio via sendAudio to the invoking chat only; format and 50 MB Telegram upload constraints are validated. 6. Audio delivery uses the existing per-chat queue, flood control, retry-after handling, and duplicate suppression, and has no heartbeat, scheduler, replay, or automatic reply hook. 7. Downloaded and generated files use private directories and 0600 files, filenames do not expose raw chat identifiers, and retention or immediate cleanup is enforced with pibot-7bo. 8. Logs and events record provider, format, duration, latency, outcome, and safe error category only; they never record audio bytes, transcript text, generated speech text, secrets, or credentials. 9. README documents supported Telegram types, local and external provider policy, privacy and retention, and opt-in behavior.
notes: Phase 1 implemented in working tree: Telegram video_note and validated audio documents; private opaque downloads with 20 MB and duration limits; ffprobe validation and bounded ffmpeg audio-only extraction; source containment and symlink rejection; immediate speech-media cleanup; target agent resolved before STT; local-first STT with external Groq denied unless explicitly listed and allowExternalStt is true in that agent speech policy; safe user-facing errors. Verification: typecheck passes and full Vitest 319/319 passes. No runtime restart, Telegram send, external STT, or paid call performed. Phase 2 local-only TTS remains in progress.
close_reason: Implemented both phases in the working tree: safe bounded video-note/audio-document ingestion with agent-scoped local-first STT policy, plus opt-in local-only speech generation and invoking-chat Telegram voice/audio delivery. Full Vitest 335/335, typecheck, diff-check, and real local say/ffmpeg OGG+M4A smoke pass. No external API call, Telegram send, restart, commit, or deploy performed.

title: media: inbound message types — voice transcription + photos + documents + friendly fallback
description: Port verity-agent's message-type handling: voice (file download -> STT provider chain groq->local whisper -> prompt as voice note), photos/documents (download to media dir, prompt references path + caption), catch-all notice for unsupported types instead of silence. Transport downloads, core transcribes/composes. STT_PROVIDERS env, GROQ_API_KEY secret. TTS outbound + transcript corrector deferred. Source pattern: github.com/glebis/verity-agent (python-telegram-bot) media.py + stt_service.py + voice_service.py.
close_reason: Landed as 4473242 (pattern from verity-agent): IncomingMedia via onMedia (voice/audio/photo/document), STT chain groq->local whisper, transcripts re-enter text pipeline (questions+commands work), file-path prompts for images/docs, catch-all notice for unsupported types. Follow-ups filed separately.

comments.author: glebis
comments.text: Verified live 2026-08-30 11:14: real 4s voice note from owner transcribed via whisperkit provider, routed into the agent turn, replied naturally. Restart #3 (cb3053d) healthy: single process 87570, no port conflicts. Remaining polish tracked in pibot-2dh (burst buffer), pibot-2sn (TTS out), pibot-7bo (media retention).

title: telegram: thread reply_to_message context into agent turns
description: Transport drops ctx.message.reply_to_message (telegram.ts:120-126). Replies arrive as bare text so agents lose which earlier message/prompt the user is responding to (esp. cards and ask_user turns). Pass reply context — quoted text + msg id, optionally map bot message ids to prior agent turns — into the prompt, e.g. '↩ replying to your message: ...'.
close_reason: Landed as 2c70935: ReplyContext via transport onMessage (telegram + cli widened), ↩ replying-to prefix composed in promptAgent, tests for extractor + prompt routing.

title: Spike: tailscale fleet feasibility (multi-machine bot group)
description: Probe: can the workshop box + Mac run tailscale, can a satellite pibot live on the box, what transport would agent-comms need over the tailnet. Exit criteria: written findings + a chosen topology (A/B/C).

comments.author: glebis
comments.text: Feasibility findings 2026-08-30: (1) Mac already runs Tailscale v1.102.3, tailnet 'glebis@' has 4 peers incl. agents-mac-mini (active, direct conn). (2) Workshop box: Ubuntu 24.04, passwordless sudo, node v22.23.2, apt available, dl.tailscale.com reachable -> tailscale installable; blocker = auth (interactive URL or auth key needed from owner). (3) Box already runs pibot typecheck+vitest fine (remote_test), so a satellite agent process is resource-trivial vs 2c/11GB. (4) Remaining unknown: agent-comms remote transport + Telegram single-poller leader lease. Verdict: all three topologies (A/B/C) physically feasible; proceed with install+auth on box as first step.

comments.text: Decision deferred (03:20, owner unsure). Next step when picked up: tailscale install on workshop box + owner auth (URL or admin key), then topology vote. Also worth asking: role of existing agents-mac-mini peer on tailnet.

title: prompts: outcome honesty tiers (solved / best_effort / blocked_with_evidence)
description: Adapt Ouroboros SYSTEM.md 'Outcome Honesty': every delegated/escalated/staged piece of work lands on one of three tiers — solved (verified), best_effort (real partial deliverable with gaps explicitly marked), blocked_with_evidence (what blocked + exact error + next action). Never inflate a tier; claiming solved without verification is worse than honest best_effort. Apply to heartbeat escalate notes, skill eval summaries, and pibot-dev staging messages.

title: prompts: failure-signal escalation + drift detector for proactive agents
description: Adapt two Ouroboros prompt patterns for pibot agents: (1) Failure-signal escalation — first tool failure may retry once; second failure of the same kind must be RECORDED (scratchpad/memory note + escalate), classified transient/structural/drift; 'six silent retries is not persistence, it is amnesia'. (2) Drift Detector from prompts/SYSTEM.md — name the anti-patterns of proactive agents so personas can self-check: task-queue mode, report mode, permission mode, amnesia, identity collapse. Add both to the default HEARTBEAT.md template and persona guidance (small constant token cost).

title: evolution: append-only checkpoints + solve-capability digest
description: Port Ouroboros evolution_checkpoints.py: append-only JSONL logging every evolution cycle outcome (promoted skill, rejected, abandoned + reason, objective/goal, timestamp). Build a compact 'solve capability digest' joining those rows that is injected into the NEXT evolution cycle's prompt, so the proposer stops re-proposing what already failed or already landed. pibot today stages/promotes/rejects skills but keeps no longitudinal memory of cycle outcomes.

title: evolution: post-task evolution envelope (durable signal, gated apply)
description: Port Ouroboros post_task_evolution.py pattern with its invariants intact: after a qualifying non-trivial chat task, the agent may write a durable evolution-request file; the NEXT idle evolution tick applies it into the existing gated cycle (staging + eval probes + owner review). Invariants to keep: worker never enqueues/applies evolution itself (durable signal only); no recursion (evolution tasks never request more evolution); promote/no-promote is a structured LLM judgment, not keywords; request is dropped if a new one supersedes; default OFF, owner-gated via agent.json. Gives 'evolve from what just happened' without breaking the stage/probe gate.

title: media: retention/cleanup policy for dataDir/media downloads
description: downloadTelegramFile writes photos/docs/ogg into dataDir/media unbounded. Add retention (age/size cap, config PIBOT_MEDIA_RETENTION) with periodic sweep via scheduler.
notes: Speech-specific retention is now implemented under pibot-2sn: inbound voice/audio/video_note/audio-document files are removed after each transcription attempt; generated local speech artifacts are private, deleted after successful send, expire after 24 hours, and sweep on store use. This issue remains open for the broader dataDir/media policy covering photos and ordinary documents plus periodic host-level cleanup.

title: media: burst/message buffer — combine rapid-fire messages into one turn
description: Verity's message_buffer.py buffers incoming messages for a short window (media groups, rapid-fire texts) into a single processing unit. pibot queues them as separate turns today (photo + 2 texts = 3 turns). Buffer ~2-3s per chat, merge texts+media into one composed prompt.
